name: langgraph
description: LangGraph agent exposed through the official A2A example a2aproject/a2a-samples (samples/python/agents/langgraph): a2a-sdk's A2AStarletteApplication publishes the Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json, and the JSON-RPC endpoint shares the same origin as the card. Default port 10000; requires Python 3.12+ and uv.

metadata.install: git clone https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-samples.git && cd a2a-samples/samples/python/agents/langgraph && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && uv sync
